name: Psyllium husk

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: Soluble mucilaginous fibre from Plantago ovata seed husk. It carries an FDA-authorised health claim for coronary heart disease risk reduction through cholesterol lowering, and is also an approved OTC bulk laxative.

systems.note: LDL cholesterol reduction through bile acid sequestration; the basis of the authorised health claim.
Bulk laxative effect is the approved OTC indication.

monitors.why: The cholesterol endpoint behind the authorised health claim.
Blunted postprandial excursion is a documented effect of viscous fibre.
